items.title: Apple patent describes AI that repaints app screenshots per keyword
items.excerpt: An Apple patent describes three Stable Diffusion models that redraw everything but the headline and phone mockup in App Store marketing images, so each search keyword gets its own screenshot creative; dependent claims let the keywords come from the app itself.

items.title: 60% of UK adults would drop an AI shopping agent after one mistake, ACI finds
items.excerpt: A YouGov poll of 2,080 UK adults for the ACI found only 19% trust AI to make everyday purchases versus 55% for a human adviser, and 60% would abandon an AI shopping agent after a single error, raising the question of who refunds when agents fail.

items.title: Meta's Muse gains self-updating tools that track prices and Instagram saves
items.excerpt: Meta's Muse agent gets 'Spaces' - self-updating tools that merge Marketplace listings with buyer messages, track orders for small sellers and watch prices and Instagram saves; Meta named no price or ad terms yet.

items.title: OpenAI Creating ChatGPT Tools For Business For Analytics & Citations
items.excerpt: OpenAI is building a Search Console-like hub that lets businesses 'claim your business in ChatGPT' and see mention and click charts for how they surface in ChatGPT answers, alongside its new ads business.

items.title: Flipsnack grows product signups with conversion optimization (ChatGPT Ads case study)
items.excerpt: OpenAI's ChatGPT Ads customer story: Flipsnack's five US conversion-optimized campaigns cut cost per registration about 75% and lifted registrations about 310% versus earlier fixed-bid click campaigns. (Page dated Nov 5 PT; first indexed 2026-11-06T00:01Z.)

items.title: Japanese pizza chain apologizes after TikTok AI tool creates unauthorized Dr. STONE ad
items.excerpt: PIZZA-LA paused all TikTok advertising after a TikTok AI-powered ad feature generated an unapproved video for its Dr. STONE anime collaboration campaign, and apologized to the rights holders.

items.title: Korean Platforms Race to Launch AI Advertising Agents
items.excerpt: Kakao, NAVER, Karrot and Toss are rolling out AI advertising agents that set up campaigns, adjust budgets and analyze results for small advertisers.

items.title: AI로 광고 만들고 카톡 추천 강화… 수익 끌어올리는 네카오
items.excerpt: 네이버가 11월 12~19일 검색광고 '파워링크'에 광고주가 등록한 소재와 연결 웹페이지를 AI가 분석해 광고 문구를 만들어 주는 'AI 문구 생성' 기능을 시범 적용하고, 카카오는 카톡 추천을 강화하는 등 네카오가 AI로 광고 수익성 강화에 나섰다.

items.title: 몰로코, '몰로콘 26' 개최…AI 광고 시스템 카라로 앱·CTV·커머스 공략
items.excerpt: 몰로코가 11월 5일 서울에서 '몰로콘 26'을 열고 AI 광고 시스템 '카라(Cara)'로 모바일 앱을 넘어 CTV·커머스 광고까지 확장하는 오픈 인터넷 광고 전략을 발표했다.

items.title: ChatGPT Ads wants premium rates, but advertisers are still waiting for results
items.excerpt: As brands test ChatGPT Ads, advertisers and agencies are questioning its premium pricing, limited measurement data and ability to prove results.

items.title: ChatGPT Ads Open a New Audience. Invalid Traffic Has Already Found It
items.excerpt: TrafficGuard found invalid clicks reached up to 34% of ChatGPT Ads campaigns across 47 advertisers, with four networks driving nearly half of them.

items.title: Chomet Denies AI Use In Dior Ad, Cites 'Automated Interpolation'
items.excerpt: Facing accusations that Dior's 'hand-drawn' holiday ad used generative AI, Sylvain Chomet and his producer cite 'automated interpolation' for in-between frames but give few technical details - the latest luxury-ad AI backlash.

items.title: LeBron James Takes Legal Action Over AI Ad That Crossed a Line
items.excerpt: LeBron James's representatives are pushing back against a viral AI-generated ad for sports-betting app 'Bron AI' that used his likeness without permission, demanding it stop.

items.title: [해외 크리에이티브] 허쉬 인도·TBWA린타스, 디왈리 맞아 AI로 제작한 '키세스' 광고 캠페인 공개
items.excerpt: 허쉬 인도와 TBWA린타스가 디왈리 시즌을 맞아 AI로 제작한 '키세스' 광고 캠페인을 공개했다.

items.title: Coty Pilots AI Discovery Tech Across Top 6 Brands to Drive Agentic Search Recommendations
items.excerpt: Coty is piloting AI discovery technology across its top six brands, including CoverGirl, to optimize how products surface in AI shopping and agentic search recommendations.

items.title: Digiday Media Buying Summit October Recap: Assessing the ups and challenges of AI's spread across the media agency landscape
items.excerpt: A recap of Digiday's Fall Media Buying Summit, which centered on how AI is spreading through media agency planning and buying and the challenges it brings.

items.title: Proceed with Caution: Pennsylvania Targets Deceptive AI in Advertising
items.excerpt: Following New York's and California's laws on AI in ads, Pennsylvania moves to target deceptive generative-AI content in advertising; marketers using AI-made creative face new disclosure and liability risk. (Page dated November 6, 2026.)

items.title: 같은 AI에 누군 울고, 누군 웃고… 메타·구글, 광고매출 격차 좁혀져
items.excerpt: 메타 광고매출이 AI 추천·광고 자동화로 26% 늘어난 반면 구글 검색 광고는 12% 성장에 그치며, AI가 두 광고 공룡의 명암을 가르고 있다.
